items.title: Peter Thiel’s $85 Million Nvidia Exit Was a Bet the Stock Had Run Far Enough. After Nvidia’s Beat, It Closed Below Every Price He Could Have Sold At
items.summary: Peter Thiel's fund sold all 537,742 of its Nvidia shares in the third quarter of 2025, a stake worth $85 million that June. The stock ran 28% past his selling range to a $239.24 record, then fell 35% and closed Tuesday at $155.46, back inside the range. After Nvidia's beat and raised forecast, his only Nvidia exposure is about $8 million through a chip ETF.
